objective: Style the composer in the single-form-card template, including the mention suggestions panel and every MediaWidget state, as wiki/CodeContext/FrontendUI/layout.md section 3 and components.md section 5 specify.
acceptance_criteria: The compose form renders inside a Card; Post uses Button variant primary, Undo mention variant ghost, and each quick-post template variant secondary.
The mention suggestions section keeps its accessible name (Game suggestions or Team suggestions) and its suggestion buttons keep their labels.
MediaWidget renders its preparing and ready messages through StatusLine, and the wrong-type, too-large and rejected messages through InlineAlert, each with unchanged text.
After a failed POST /posts the failure renders through InlineAlert and the draft text is still in the text box.
The suggestions panel's CSS uses var(--z-dropdown) (static).

Every *.module.css file this unit adds contains no hex, rgb(), hsl() or named colour, no px font size, and no outline: none or outline: 0 without a :focus-visible rule in the same file (a static test reads the files from disk).
component-isolation.test.ts and every existing compose test pass unchanged.
Every existing test in the suite passes unchanged; no existing test file is edited.
